pages.name: Four Knights: Symmetrical, 7.Bg5 Bxc3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a knight from c3 (it was taken on c3; White has pawns there) and plan 4 targeted a c4-pawn that doesn't exist; plan 2 missed the Metger Unpin. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 to 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Four Knights: Symmetrical, Metger, 10.d4 Ne6
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the light-squared bishop via d2-e1-h4 (it is on b5; the g5-bishop is the one under attack from the e6-knight). Rewritten around Bc1 or Bh4; overview notes the knight hits g5. British spelling in plan 2 and the overview.

pages.name: Four Knights: Symmetrical, Metger, 10.d4 Ne6 11.Bc1 c5
pages.notes: Plan 1's Ba3 'pressuring d6' (it hits c5) and plan 2's vague 'light-square blockade' rewritten; overview mentions 11...c5 against d4. British spelling.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Italian Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1's route 'e2-g3' could not be read and the overview missed the fork trick 5.Nxe5 Nxe5 6.d4; rewrote the overview and both plans (6...Bd6 7.dxe5 Bxe5, or the quiet 5.d3).

pages.name: Giuoco Pianissimo: 4.d3 Nf6 5.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1's Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook still on f1; rewritten with Re1 first. Plan 2 rewritten around ...a6 and ...Ba7. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Giuoco Pianissimo: 4.d3 Nf6 5.O-O d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3 (it is the b1-knight, and the rook stands on f1); plan 2's ...a6 'to prevent Nb5' (no knight can reach b5). Both rewritten; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Giuoco Pianissimo: Canal, 6...h6
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 3 assumed ...gxf6 after 7.Bxf6 (the queen recaptures, and 8.Nd5 hits it and c7); plan 4 put the light-squared bishop on g7. Rewrote the overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Giuoco Pianissimo: Italian Four Knights, 5...d6 6.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 3 is correct but the parser can't read fxe3 after ...Bxe3 in an unprefixed plan; added to the skips. British spelling in the overview and plans 2 to 4; no reviewer verdict needed beyond spelling.

pages.name: Giuoco Piano: 4.O-O Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3's Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook on f1 (now after Re1); plan 1's unreadable 'c3-d4' rewritten. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Giuoco Piano: 4.O-O Nf6 5.Nc3
pages.notes: The overview and plans missed the fork trick 5...Nxe4 6.Nxe4 d5 that makes 5.Nc3 harmless; plan 1 pushed c3 with the knight on c3; plan 2 called the c3-knight the b1-knight. Rewrote the overview and all four plans.
